name: Default Scanner User-Agent on External Surface
description:
HTTP request hits NBI's external surface carrying a default
user-agent fingerprint of a well-known active-scanner tool — Nmap,
Masscan, Amass, Nuclei, sqlmap, dirb, gobuster, ffuf, Burp Suite
default. ScanWave's Variant A (Loud) uses these exact UAs by design;
this rule is the baseline-detection canary.
false_positives: Internal pentest team running a scan from inside-out (excluded by
Trusted Agent (ScanWave) executing Variant A — TP-Verified, no
query:
@timestamp >= "now-15m" and
data.http_agent: (
    *Nmap Scripting Engine* or
    *sqlmap* or
    *Nuclei* or
    *ffuf* or
    *gobuster* or
    *dirb* or
    *Masscan* or
    *amass* or
    *nikto* or
    *Acunetix* or
    "*ZAP*" or
    *XSStrike* or
    *Burp Suite* or
    *Hydra* or
    *Kerbrute* or
    *MSOLSpray* or
    *WPScan* 
) and not source.ip: ("10.0.0.0/8" or "192.168.0.0/16" or "172.16.0.0/12")
